3-Piece Baby Feeding Bowl Set with Sealed Storage

The 3-Piece Baby Feeding Bowl Set provides practical feeding solutions for babies aged 7-12 months. This portable set includes microwave-safe bowls with sealed storage boxes, designed for complementary food introduction and everyday use.

Safe PP Material Construction

Crafted from PVC-free PP material, these feeding bowls meet safety standards for baby products. The durable construction withstands daily use, microwave heating, and regular cleaning. The patchwork pattern adds visual interest during feeding time.

60ML Capacity Square Design

Each bowl holds 60ML of food, suitable for serving purees, cereals, and complementary foods. The square shape provides stability on flat surfaces, reducing spills during self-feeding practice. The compact size fits easily in diaper bags for on-the-go feeding.

Microwave-Safe with Sealed Storage

Heat prepared meals directly in these microwave-safe bowls without transferring food between containers. The sealed storage boxes keep pre-prepared meals fresh in the refrigerator, simplifying meal prep routines. Lids prevent spills during transport and maintain food freshness.

Portable Feeding Solution

The lightweight design makes this set practical for travel, daycare, and visits to family. The three-piece configuration provides multiple bowls for different foods or meal prep throughout the day. Suitable for babies transitioning to solid foods between 7-12 months of age.

Product Specifications

  • Material: PVC-free PP
  • Capacity: 60ML per bowl
  • Shape: Square
  • Quantity: 3 pieces
  • Age Range: 7-12 months
  • Features: Microwave-safe, sealed storage, portable
  • Pattern: Patchwork

products.title: 3-Piece Wheat Straw Baby Feeding Set - Bear Bowl, Spoon & Fork
products.body_html:
3-Piece Wheat Straw Baby Feeding Set with Cartoon Bear Design

This 3-piece baby feeding set combines eco-friendly materials with a charming cartoon bear design, creating an engaging mealtime experience for toddlers aged 1-2 years. Crafted from wheat straw and PP material, the set prioritizes safety and durability for daily feeding routines.

What's Included

The complete feeding set contains three essential pieces: a 20cm (7.87in) diameter bowl for serving cereals, pasta, and various meals; a 15.5cm x 3.3cm (6.1in x 1.3in) spoon designed for small hands to encourage self-feeding; and a 15.5cm x 2.5cm (6.1in x 0.98in) fork that helps develop fine motor skills. Available in three colors—pink, blue, and beige—to match your child's preferences and nursery decor.

Material & Safety Features

The wheat straw construction offers an eco-friendly alternative to traditional plastic feeding sets. Combined with high-quality PP material, this feeding set ensures durability through countless meals while remaining safe for toddler use. The lightweight design makes it easy for children to handle independently.

Practical Applications

Use this feeding set for everyday breakfast, lunch, and dinner meals. The appealing bear design helps introduce new foods to hesitant eaters, making food exploration less stressful. Perfect for playdates and family gatherings where your toddler can dine alongside others. The set also serves well during snack time for fruits, yogurt, and small bites. Makes a practical gift for baby showers or first birthday celebrations.

Age-Appropriate Design

Specifically sized for toddlers aged 1-2 years, each utensil promotes independence and proper grip development. The spoon and fork dimensions accommodate small hands learning to self-feed, while the bowl's 20cm diameter provides ample space for portion-appropriate meals. The cartoon bear motif captures attention and creates positive mealtime associations.

products.title: 360° Sippy Cup - Leakproof 240ml Baby Training Cup (1-2 Years)
products.body_html:
360° Leakproof Sippy Cup for Independent Drinking

The Magic Baby Cups feature a 360-degree drinking edge that allows your baby to sip from any angle without spills. Designed for babies aged 1-2 years, this training cup makes the transition from bottle to cup smooth and mess-free.

Key Features

360-Degree Drinking Design: The innovative rim allows your child to drink from any side of the cup, promoting natural drinking skills and oral development. No special spout required - just tilt and sip.

Leakproof Technology: The valve-activated system prevents spills and leaks, even when turned upside down. Your child can carry it around without creating messes on floors, furniture, or in diaper bags.

240ml Capacity: The perfectly sized 240ml capacity is ideal for small hands and provides enough liquid for snack time, meals, or on-the-go hydration. Not too heavy when full, making it easy for toddlers to hold independently.

Supports Developmental Milestones

This baby training cup helps develop independent drinking skills while reducing dependency on bottles. The 360-degree design encourages proper oral motor development and helps prevent dental issues associated with traditional sippy cup spouts.

Versatile Use

Suitable for water, juice, or milk, this training cup works for various beverages throughout the day. Use it at home during meals, pack it in your diaper bag for outings, or send it to daycare for consistent drinking practice.

Perfect for Ages 1-2 Years

Specifically designed for babies and toddlers in the critical transition phase from bottle to cup. The easy-to-grip design and lightweight construction make it manageable for developing motor skills while building confidence in independent drinking.

Frequently Asked Questions about Gol Plat Gold Plated Beads

What is the main benefit of using Gol Plat Gold Plated Beads?  

The main benefit of Gol Plat Gold Plated Beads is their ability to provide the elegant, lustrous look of solid gold at a much lower cost. They are also designed with a durable finish that resists tarnishing and wear, making them a reliable choice for long-lasting jewelry.

Will the gold plating on Gol Plat beads wear off over time?

While the plating on Gol Plat Gold Plated Beads is durable and designed for longevity, excessive friction or exposure to harsh chemicals can cause it to wear over a long period. Proper care, such as avoiding contact with perfumes and lotions, will help extend the life of the plating.

Are Gol Plat beads safe for sensitive skin?  

Yes, Gol Plat Gold Plated Beads are made with a hypoallergenic plating over a base metal that is typically free of common allergens like nickel and lead. This makes them a safe and comfortable option for those with sensitive skin.

How should a person care for jewelry made with Gol Plat Gold Plated Beads?  

To care for jewelry made with Gol Plat Gold Plated Beads, it is recommended to avoid contact with water, sweat, chemicals, and lotions. Storing the jewelry in a dry, enclosed space will also help preserve its shine. A soft, dry cloth can be used for gentle cleaning.

Are Gol Plat Gold Plated Beads suitable for all types of jewelry projects?  

Yes, the wide range of sizes, shapes, and designs available makes Gol Plat Gold Plated Beads highly versatile. They can be used for necklaces, bracelets, earrings, and other creative projects, providing a high-quality gold finish to any design.

What is the base metal used for Gol Plat beads?

The base metal for Gol Plat Gold Plated Beads is typically a durable and strong metal such as brass or copper. This provides a solid foundation for the gold plating and ensures the bead holds its shape and integrity.

Can a person solder or heat Gol Plat beads?  

No, it is not recommended to solder or apply heat directly to Gol Plat Gold Plated Beads. The heat can damage or melt the thin layer of gold plating, causing discoloration or a compromised finish.

products.body_html:
Silicone Baby Bib – Waterproof Feeding Protection for Infants & Toddlers

The CradleLuxe Silicone Baby Bib provides reliable protection during mealtime with food-grade, BPA-free silicone construction. This waterproof feeding bib shields clothing from spills, dribbles, and stains while remaining gentle on sensitive skin.

The soft, flexible material moves naturally with your baby, ensuring comfort throughout feeding sessions. A deep catch pocket collects falling food and liquids, significantly reducing cleanup time. Adjustable straps accommodate infants and toddlers of various sizes, providing a secure fit that stays in place. The lightweight, durable design makes this bib suitable for home use, daycare environments, or travel.

Product Features

  • Safe Silicone Material: BPA-free, non-toxic, and baby-friendly.
  • Waterproof Design: Protects clothing from spills and dribbles.
  • Deep Food Pocket: Catches falling food to minimize mess.
  • Adjustable & Comfortable: Fits infants and toddlers securely.
  • Easy to Clean: Dishwasher safe or rinse with water for quick cleaning.

Why Choose Food-Grade Silicone?

Food-grade silicone offers distinct advantages for baby feeding products. The material resists staining and odor absorption, maintaining hygiene across repeated uses. Unlike fabric bibs that require washing and drying, silicone bibs clean instantly with a quick rinse or dishwasher cycle. The waterproof barrier prevents liquids from soaking through to clothing, while the flexible texture remains comfortable against delicate skin.

Deep Pocket Design

The integrated catch pocket extends outward to collect dropped food and spilled liquids before they reach your baby's lap or the floor. This design feature proves particularly valuable during self-feeding stages when infants and toddlers are developing motor skills. The pocket capacity handles substantial amounts of food, reducing the frequency of mid-meal cleanups.

Adjustable Fit for Growing Babies

Multiple adjustment settings on the neck strap allow the bib to grow with your child from early infancy through toddler years. The secure closure prevents removal by curious hands while maintaining comfort. The flexible silicone conforms to different body shapes without creating pressure points or restricting movement.

Maintenance and Care

Cleaning requires minimal effort—place the bib on the top rack of your dishwasher or rinse under running water. The non-porous silicone surface prevents bacterial growth and wipes clean without scrubbing. The material withstands repeated washing without degrading, cracking, or losing flexibility.

The CradleLuxe Silicone Baby Bib combines practical functionality with durable construction for reliable feeding protection.

Introducing the Baby Fruit and Vegetable Teether Food Supplement Bite Le Silicone Baby Feeding Tableware – the perfect solution for introducing your little one to the joys of solid food! Designed with care and attention to detail, this innovative silicone feeder is ideal for infants and toddlers aged 0-36 months, making mealtime a delightful experience for both you and your baby.

Crafted from food-grade PP and silicone, our feeder ensures that every bite is safe and hygienic. Available in vibrant colors like Yellow, Blue, Pink, and Green, it’s not just functional but also visually appealing!

Secure the lid to prevent any leaks, and let your baby explore new flavors! Babies over 3 months can enjoy rice cereal and fruit purees, while those over 6 months can munch on small pieces of fruits and vegetables. Once they reach 12 months, you can introduce protein-rich foods like fish fillets and ground meat. This feeder not only helps with the transition to solid foods but also promotes healthy chewing habits, keeping your baby’s gums and teeth in great condition.

Tips for use:

1. Our silicone mesh bag is made from high-quality, food-grade silicone rubber that is safe, non-toxic, and tasteless. It’s durable, easy to clean, and designed to withstand the rigors of mealtime. Please note that darker fruits and vegetables may stain the silicone mesh, which is normal and does not affect its functionality.

2. As each feeder is measured by hand, please allow for a slight error of 2-3 cm. Make sure you are comfortable with this before making your purchase.

3. Due to variations in display settings, the color of the actual product may differ slightly from the images. We appreciate your understanding!

products.body_html:
WATERPROOF SILICONE BABY BIB WITH DEEP POCKET

Mealtime spills and drool create constant outfit changes and laundry loads for busy parents. The Waterproof Silicone Baby Bib solves this problem with a durable, easy-clean design that keeps babies dry and comfortable during feeding, teething, and play.

This silicone bib features a built-in pocket that catches food and liquid spills before they reach clothing. The waterproof material blocks moisture completely, while the lightweight 100g construction ensures babies can wear it comfortably for extended periods. Measuring 29cm x 23cm, it provides full coverage for newborns through toddlers.

KEY FEATURES OF THE SILICONE BABY BIB

✅ 100% WATERPROOF SILICONE—Medical-grade silicone material creates an impermeable barrier against liquids. Spills, drool, and food stay on the bib surface instead of soaking through to clothes.

✅ DEEP CATCH POCKET—The built-in pocket design traps falling food and liquids before they hit the floor or baby's lap. Parents spend less time cleaning up after meals.

✅ ADJUSTABLE SNAP CLOSURE—Multiple snap settings accommodate growing babies from 3 months through toddler years. The secure closure stays in place during active feeding sessions.

✅ WIPES CLEAN INSTANTLY—Silicone material rinses clean under running water in seconds. Machine washable and dishwasher safe for thorough sanitization between uses.

✅ SOFT, FLEXIBLE DESIGN—The silicone bends and moves with baby's movements without restricting comfort. Smooth edges prevent irritation on delicate neck skin.

✅ LIGHTWEIGHT & PORTABLE—At just 100g, this bib folds flat for easy transport in diaper bags. Perfect for restaurants, travel, and visits to family.

HOW TO USE YOUR SILICONE BABY BIB

1. Select the appropriate snap closure size for your baby's neck

2. Secure the bib with the adjustable snaps for a comfortable fit

3. Position the pocket to catch spills during feeding or play

Studies show over 70% of parents change baby clothes multiple times daily due to feeding messes. The Waterproof Silicone Baby Bib eliminates this frustration with its completely waterproof construction and catch-all pocket design. Parents save time on laundry while babies stay dry and comfortable throughout the day.
